name: proton-pass
title: Proton Pass
description: Search and manage Proton Pass items, generate passwords, and retrieve TOTP codes through pass-cli.
author: Arduoi

commands.name: search-items
commands.title: Search Proton Pass Items
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: Search all Proton Pass items across vaults and copy credentials.

commands.name: list-vaults
commands.title: List Proton Pass Vaults
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: View Proton Pass vaults and browse their items.

commands.name: generate-password
commands.title: Generate Proton Pass Password
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: Generate a configurable random password or passphrase through pass-cli.

commands.name: get-totp
commands.title: Get Proton Pass TOTP Code
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: List Proton Pass items, choose one, and copy its current TOTP code.

commands.name: check-strength
commands.title: Check Password Strength
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: Score a password with pass-cli and list its weaknesses.

commands.name: login
commands.title: Login to Proton Pass
commands.subtitle: pass-cli
commands.description: Check or start the local Proton Pass CLI session.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: pass-cli path
preferences.description: Path to pass-cli, or leave as pass-cli to use PATH.

preferences.name: closeAfterCopy
preferences.title: Close after copy
preferences.label: Close the Vicinae window after copying a value
preferences.description: When enabled, copying shows a brief HUD and closes the launcher.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary action
preferences.description: Which action runs first (Enter) on an item in Search Proton Pass Items.

preferences.name: secondaryAction
preferences.title: Secondary action
preferences.description: Which action is promoted to second place on an item in Search Proton Pass Items.

preferences.name: defaultPasswordLength
preferences.title: Default password length
preferences.description: Initial random-password length; the command supports 8–128 characters.

preferences.name: enableBackgroundRefresh
preferences.title: Background metadata refresh
preferences.label: Refresh cached vault and item metadata in the background
preferences.description: Show cached metadata immediately while refreshing stale entries.

preferences.name: cacheExpiration
preferences.title: Metadata cache expiration
preferences.description: How long vault and item metadata remains fresh.

preferences.name: copyPasswordTransient
preferences.title: Transient password and TOTP clipboard
preferences.label: Clear copied passwords and TOTP codes automatically
preferences.description: Only clears the clipboard if it still contains the copied secret.

preferences.name: clipboardClearSeconds
preferences.title: Secret clipboard timeout
preferences.description: How long copied passwords and TOTP codes remain in the clipboard.
